Frequently Asked Questions — Clinic Website Design Kerala

items.q: How long does Clinic Website Design Kerala take?
items.a: A standard clinic site with services, practitioner profiles, and booking forms typically takes two to four weeks. A larger multi-practitioner build can take four to six weeks.

items.q: How much does an Affordable Clinic Website Design Kerala build cost?
items.a: Cost depends on whether appointment booking or a patient portal is included — a basic informational site costs far less than a full booking-integrated build.

items.q: Is an Ayurveda Clinic Website Design Kerala build different from a resort wellness site?
items.a: Yes — this is a standalone medical treatment practice with no accommodation, built around treatments, practitioner credentials, and appointment booking, distinct from wellness tourism sites built around stays.

items.q: Can a Dental Clinic Website Design Kerala practice show before-and-after photos?
items.a: Yes — treatment galleries are a standard feature for dental and cosmetic practices, alongside procedure descriptions and practitioner credentials.

items.q: Will patient reviews be visible on the website itself?
items.a: Yes — Clinic Website Design with Patient Reviews Kerala work displays genuine reviews on service and practitioner pages, not just linked out to Google.

items.q: Does a single doctor practice need the same features as a larger clinic?
items.a: Mostly yes, at a smaller scale — Single Doctor Clinic Website Design Kerala builds still need booking, credentials, and services, just without the multi-practitioner navigation a larger clinic requires.
